description: Restores a database from a backup (the last successful one by default) or to a point in time; its current data is replaced, with an approval in production.

approval_id.description: The granted approval (its id), when the action needs one.

backup_id.description: The backup (get_environment { view: "backups" }); the last successful one by default.

database.description: Database name; the first declared by default.

instant.description: Restore the database to this instant (ISO 8601), 14 days at most; excludes backup_id.

reason.description: Why restore, in one sentence for the person who approves.

name: restore_backup
title: Restore a database
